description: Source file implementing HTTP log utilities, including header redaction and logging functions for HTTP request and response headers.

methods.name: ShouldRedactChallenge
methods.description: Determines if an authentication challenge should be redacted based on its scheme and content.

methods.name: ElideHeaderValueForNetLog
methods.description: Redacts sensitive parts of HTTP header values for logging, based on header type and capture mode.

methods.name: NetLogResponseHeaders
methods.description: Logs HTTP response headers to the net log.

methods.name: NetLogRequestHeaders
methods.description: Logs HTTP request headers to the net log.
